mechanism.name: channel-serial symmetric-halo block FFT convolution
mechanism.change: construct and release one channel strip and horizontal pad at a time
mechanism.unchanged: P6ZA kernel, float64 arithmetic, 512-row chunk, output allocation and FFT convolution order per channel

forbidden_fallbacks: change kernel, dtype, row chunk, image shape, fixture, run order or gates
exclude any run or retain a post-result memory threshold exception
alter FFT result ordering or quantize intermediates
claim native/mobile/GPU, measured scanner or product performance

branch_rule.pass: retain the channel-serial block FFT as local CPU development compiler and open combined-chain measurement
branch_rule.fail: close Python block-FFT optimization and retain the full-frame FFT reference

claim_ceiling: Local Windows/Python numerical and fresh-process resource evidence for one channel-serial block-FFT scanner-glare compiler only; not measured scanner calibration, native/mobile/GPU performance, photographic quality or product readiness.
